title: Supra
extract:
The Supra is a  Corpus tri-barrel laser minigun unlockable through Energy Lab Research in the Dojo. It is used by Corpus Techs and sometimes by Corpus Wardens throughout Corpus-controlled regions, and is effectively the Corpus standard machine gun.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
Requires a spool-up of 5 shots before optimal fire rate is achieved.
Fire rate starts at 10% of the listed value, and increases by 22.5% per shot.
Can equip the Supra-exclusive  Directed Convergence and  Entropy Burst mods.
Advantages over other Primary Auto-Spool Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Fully Spooled (wiki attack index 1)
High burst DPS (548)
High sustained DPS (453.51)
Above average magazine size (180)
High damage per shot (43.84)
Very high total damage (40)
Very high reload speed (3.00 s)
High ammo max (1,080)
Very high status chance (30.00%)
Disadvantages over other Primary Auto-Spool Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Projectiles have travel time, making long range shots more difficult.
Spool-up creates a warm-up period of weakness for fire rate, making short engagements undesirable.
Fully Spooled (wiki attack index 1)
Very low crit chance (12.00%)
Low accuracy (6.00° to 8.00°)
Very low fire rate (12.50 attacks/sec)
Low disposition (●●●○○ (1.10x))
Low crit multiplier (1.80x)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Comparisons:

 Supra (Fully Spooled), compared to  Supra Vandal (Fully Spooled):
Equal base damage
Lower base critical chance (12.00% vs. 16.00%)
Lower base critical multiplier (1.80x vs. 2.00x)
Lower average damage per tap (43.84 vs. 46.4)
Lower burst DPS (548 vs. 580)
Lower sustained DPS (453.51 vs. 515.55)
Smaller magazine (180 vs. 300)
Smaller max ammo capacity (1,080 vs. 1,600)
Slower spool-up (5 rounds vs. 4 rounds)
Less accurate (14.3 vs. 28.6)
Wider first-shot spread (6.00° vs. 3.00°)
Wider maximum spread (8.00° vs. 4.00°)
Lower Mastery Rank required (12 vs. 14)
Higher disposition (●●●○○ (1.10x) vs. ●●●○○ (1.00x))

Acquisition
The Supra's blueprint can be researched from the Energy Lab in the dojo.

This weapon can be sold for  7,500.

Notes
Cancelling the reload animation on its third-quarter period counts as a reload, much like the  Soma.

Tips
Supra has a decent fire rate like the Gorgon, but it is less accurate at longer distances. Firing in short bursts may help with accuracy.
Alternatively, use the mods  Stabilizer or  Vile Precision to reduce the high recoil, and make it more comfortable to fire overall.
To counter the weapon's quick ammo consumption, it would be ideal to bring Squad Ammo Restores,  Rifle Ammo Mutation, Carrier with  Ammo Case,  Vigilante Supplies and/or the  Rifle Scavenger aura.
 Shred or  Metal Auger can help hit more enemies, somewhat balancing the high ammo consumption.

Trivia
Supra is Latin for "above".
The Supra's magazine is the large boxy object on the top of the gun, and presumably doubles as a sight due to the notch.
The Supra's energy goes dark when the magazine has been taken out during reloading, and will light up again after the magazine has been replaced.
The magazine might be a battery or fuel as opposed to ammunition, due to this
The Supra is the first weapon to receive two augment mods;  Entropy Burst from the Cephalon Suda Syndicate and  Directed Convergence from the Conclave Syndicate.
Although the Supra is labeled as a "laser gun" in its description. It is actually a plasma weapon.
